name: Tri-linear Interpolation via LRP
definition: A GPU-based tri-linear interpolation method using the LRP (linear interpolation) instruction, fetching 8 nearest neighbors via pre-computed texture coordinates.
summary: Tri-linear Interpolation via LRP is a GPU-accelerated method that estimates volumetric scalar values by leveraging hardware rasterization to interpolate texture coordinates for free, distinguishing itself from CPU-based raycasting.
